main_text.l: Cuculi tui coccysmis repetijsse. Nam inspice Guidmundu, inspice
Lanfrancum, qui, quod Transsubstantiationi faueret, & Roma-
næ sedi vellet, Berengarianam Palinodiam, vt tu quoq; ijsdem ni-
mirum causis adductus, contra Berengarium defendit: & inue-
nies vtrumq; eodem modo & ijsdem verbis istam Palinodiam,
pro qua tu tanquam focis & aris pugnas, concepisse & legisse. Neq;
credibile est Andræa duos istos, quibus Nicolai Papæ dignitas &
confessio non minori curæ fuit quam tibi, in Palinodia citanda &
legenda crimen falsi commisisse: quippe cum eam omnibus viri-
bus propugnare decreuissent.

l.i: At vero, inquis, in Decreto Iuris Canonici, quod hodie in manibus hominum
est, aliter, atque authorem Orthodoxi Consensus legisse.

main_text.l: Ita sane se res habet Andrea: sed meminisse te oportebat eum,
qui Decretum Iphonis edidit in præfatione testari pleraq; in De-
creto Iuris Canonici, quo nunc vtimur, valde depravate esse cita-
ta, quæ ex Iphonis Decreto, ex quo sua compilauit Gratianus, re-
stituenda sint. Nunc iudica pie Lector, vtrum Andreas, an vero
author Orthodoxi Consensus criminis falsi admissi accusari &
convinci possit: quippe cum hic sui lectionis Guidmundum, Lan-
francum, Iphonem, vetustissimos authores testes & suffragatores
habeat: Andreas vero suam lectionem & calumniosam accusa-
tionem ex lacunis corrupti & depravati exemplaris hauserit. Hic
Andrea si potes hisce, hic si potes calumniæ suspicione te libera.
Et certe plurima eiusmodi fidei tuæ & candoris in Confutatione
Orthodoxi Consensus extant documenta: quæ haud multum post
detegentur & Christiano Lectori dijudicanda proponentur: vt
tandem omnes tuas artes intelligant & execrentur. Sed quid am-
plius? Deinde, ais, responsum est ijsdem phrasibus, quas Palinodia habeat, &

page.notes: Lines 1–3 at the top and the line "Cuculi tui" are running text, not a running head. Doubtful readings: "Lanfrancum" and "Iphonem" as printed; "hiscendo" and "ijsdem" as printed; "Berengarianam" as printed. The paragraph beginning "Si is Cuculus" continues onto the page's last full line. Long s rendered as s throughout; "Ita sane" and "Neq;" transcribed as printed. The italic passage "Deinde, ais..." is set in italics with black letter for "Patres vtantur" omitted from the black-letter markup, which is probably italic in the print; please verify.
